behaviour: The Firestore scene keeps the encrypted bare element array in ciphertext/iv for old clients and stores the page list in its own encrypted pagesCiphertext/pagesIv fields; a document without them reads as the default page.
rules: 1. FirebaseStoredScene gains optional `pagesCiphertext?: Bytes` and `pagesIv?: Bytes`; sceneVersion, iv and ciphertext keep their names and types.
2. encryptElements and decryptElements stay exactly as today: ciphertext is UTF-8 JSON.stringify of the bare element array.

3. New private encryptPages(key, pages): encryptData(key, UTF-8 JSON.stringify(pages)) returning { ciphertext, iv } like encryptElements; new private decryptPages(data, roomKey): return createDefaultPages() when data.pagesCiphertext or data.pagesIv is missing, else decryptData(pagesIv, pagesCiphertext, roomKey), JSON.parse and restorePages(parsed).

4. One version value = getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages); FirebaseSceneVersionCache.set(socket, elements, pages) stores it, isSavedToFirebase compares it, createFirebaseSceneDocument writes it to sceneVersion.
5. createFirebaseSceneDocument(elements, pages, roomKey) returns { sceneVersion, ciphertext, iv, pagesCiphertext, pagesIv } (all Bytes.fromUint8Array as today).

6. isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, pages); saveToFirebase(portal, elements, appState) bails on isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, appState.pages); a new document is written with transaction.set(docRef, doc) holding all five fields; an existing one reconciles elements as today, reconciles pages = reconcilePages(appState.pages, await decryptPages(prevStoredScene, roomKey)) and writes all five fields with transaction.update(docRef, doc).

7. After the transaction saveToFirebase decrypts the stored document's elements (as today) and pages (decryptPages), sets the version cache from both, and returns { elements, pages }; it returns null where it returns null today.
8. loadFromFirebase returns { elements, pages } | null: elements as today, pages = decryptPages(storedScene, roomKey); it sets the version cache from both.
9. Page names never leave the encrypted pages payload and are never logged.

behaviour: Receives, reconciles and applies the page list with the elements, and counts page versions so page-only changes are broadcast and saved.
rules: 1. private getCollabSceneVersion(elements, pages) = getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages); every place that compared or stored getSceneVersion(elements) (broadcastElements, queueBroadcastAllElements, _reconcileElements, initializeRoom) uses it with excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages (or the reconciled/loaded pages).
2. private _reconcilePages(remotePages | undefined): when undefined return the local pages unchanged; else reconcilePages(localPages, restorePages(remotePages)).

3. handleRemoteSceneUpdate(elements, pages?) calls updateScene({ elements, appState: pages ? { pages, activePageId: resolveActivePageId(pages, appState.activePageId) } : undefined, captureUpdate: NEVER }); the local activePageId only changes when its page became a tombstone (FR-21).

4. SCENE_INIT and SCENE_UPDATE handlers pass decryptedData.payload.pages through _reconcilePages to handleRemoteSceneUpdate; scenePromise resolves with appState { pages, activePageId } when pages were received.
5. saveCollabRoomToFirebase applies the stored { elements, pages } result through _reconcileElements and _reconcilePages; the beforeunload check passes appState.pages to isSavedToFirebase.
6. initializeRoom returns { elements, appState: { pages, activePageId: resolveActivePageId(pages, null) }, scrollToContent: true } from loadFromFirebase's { elements, pages }.
7. broadcastElements also broadcasts when only the pages version grew; syncElements is unchanged in signature (pages are read from excalidrawAPI.getAppState()).

8. startCollaboration for a new room (no existingRoomLinkData) builds its elements from every page's non-deleted elements, getNonDeletedElements(excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted()), so updateScene (NEVER, no appState) and saveCollabRoomToFirebase keep every page; the pending-image mapping and the deleted-element comment stay.
